MODEL. Qwen3.5-0.8B (text part): 24 decoder layers of width 1,024. PRE-NORM: input_layernorm before attention and post_attention_layernorm before the MLP; sublayer outputs are added to the residual stream directly (no norm on the outputs). writable modules: for each layer i = 0..23, mlp.down_proj (1024 x 3584) and the attention output projection: model.layers.{i}.self_attn.o_proj for i in {3,7,11,15,19,23}, model.layers.{i}.linear_attn.out_proj otherwise (both 1024 x 2048). Use module names model.layers.{i}... in the adapter; in model.safetensors the same weights are stored under model.language_model.layers.{i}...weight.

import json, numpy as np
PATH='/workspace/model/model.safetensors-00001-of-00001.safetensors'
_hdr=None; _base=None
def header():
    global _hdr,_base
    if _hdr is None:
        with open(PATH,'rb') as fh:
            n=int.from_bytes(fh.read(8),'little')
            _hdr=json.loads(fh.read(n)); _base=8+n
    return _hdr,_base
def load(k):
    hdr,base=header()
    e=hdr[k]
    with open(PATH,'rb') as fh:
        fh.seek(base+e['data_offsets'][0])
        raw=fh.read(e['data_offsets'][1]-e['data_offsets'][0])
    if e['dtype']=='BF16':
        b=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype=np.uint16).astype(np.uint32)
        a=(b<<16).view(np.float32)
    elif e['dtype']=='F32':
        a=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype=np.float32)
    else:
        raise ValueError(e['dtype'])
    return a.reshape(e['shape'])
def names():
    hdr,_=header(); return list(hdr.keys())
PYEOF
